title: Runtime pair lock (ODOC-328): lore X must refuse to drive quest != X
description: Operator-directed (ODOC-OP-2026-09-29-02), binding text read by ref at opum-doc origin/main docs/adr/lock-lore-and-quest-to-their-exact-pair-version-at-runtime.md (Accepted 2026-09-29, ODOC-328): lore X runs only against quest X, compared on the full version; a mismatch FAILS (not a warning) naming both installed versions and the side to upgrade; lore checks the quest it drives. Open details (exit code, message text, hook point) are lore-cli's to propose through opum-agent (OPAG-748). PROPOSED (sent to opum-agent 2026-09-29): single boundary at the quest adapter's probe()/ensure() gate in src/adapters/quest.ts (every quest-backed command passes through it by construction); exit 6 error_type validation with input.code quest.version-pair-mismatch; message 'the lore X / quest Y pair version requirement is not met: lore X requires quest X' + hint naming the install of the side behind. Alternative proposed: a per-command assertPair() guard. Implementation is dispatched only after the operator's decision and ships in a pair release (Article 3). Do not start implementation before that.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The proposal (recommended hook point + one alternative, each with quality/speed/cost, plus exit code and exact message text) is sent to opum-agent for OPAG-748 and ledgered there.

After the operator decision: lore refuses to drive a quest whose full version differs from lore's own, exiting 6 with a message naming both installed versions and the side to upgrade; the refusal is covered by a test proving both directions and the exact-match rule. Ships in a pair release (Article 3); no standalone release.

plan: 1. Read DEC-31 first-party (done: opum-agent origin/main 39cfb13, status accepted, option A) and ODOC-328; record the read on the task.

2. src/adapters/quest.ts: replace the 0.2.7 floor with exact raw-string equality at probe(); LoreError validation/6, input.code=quest.version-pair-mismatch, the pair sentence + upgrade hint naming the side behind (semver triple; no guess when only a suffix differs).

3. Consumers: init.ts's fatal-set gains isQuestVersionPairMismatch (selection refuses a mismatched pair); tracker-migration.ts / tracker-cutover.ts floor messages become the exact version; MIN_QUEST_VERSION + floor predicate retired or re-pointed rather than left as dead code.

4. Tests: quest-adapter fixtures report VERSION via src/meta; the accept-list test inverts to both refusal directions with message + discriminator; init selection case; CLI-level exit-6 envelope case.
5. Docs: adapter module comment rewritten to the lock (ODOC-328/DEC-31); release runbook records the bump-order coupling (package.json X needs quest X on npm for the docs gate).
6. Gates: bun test + bun run lore check on the pinned runtime, solo; PR into dev; reviewer pass if scripts/ or release.yml is touched.
implementationNotes: STARTED 2026-09-29. DEC-31 read FIRST-PARTY at opum-agent origin/main 39cfb13 in .quest/planning.json: status accepted, option A adopted -- check once at the quest adapter's probe() gate, exact equality in place of the 0.2.7 floor, exit 6 validation, discriminator { code: quest.version-pair-mismatch, lore, quest }, the pair sentence plus an upgrade hint. Quest-cli records the contract only (their measurement: quest never invokes lore from any shipped path, so the runtime lock lives in lore); opum-cli-e2e adds the preflight and mismatchProbe. Ships in a pair release (Article 3); no release cut here. ONE COUPLING FOUND WHILE SCOPING, to surface rather than decide: with the lock, every CI job that runs lore from source against quest needs quest on npm at exactly lore's package.json version -- the docs gate installs the version CLAUDE.md declares, so at a version bump (package.json X) quest X must ALREADY be published, or that required context cannot go green. Under the staged pair release lore's bump PR would therefore need quest X published before it lands, which is an ordering constraint on LCLI-621's machinery (currently Paused) and opum-agent's campaign. Recorded here and reported to the orchestrator; not implemented around.

IMPLEMENTED on fix/LCLI-650-pair-lock (off origin/dev). CODE: src/adapters/quest.ts -- probe() compares the trimmed `quest --version` string to VERSION (src/meta) by exact equality; pairVersionMismatch builds the refusal with LoreError validation/6, input { code: quest.version-pair-mismatch, lore, quest }, the sentence 'the lore X / quest Y pair version requirement is not met: lore X requires quest X' and a hint naming the side behind by semver triple (no guess when only a pre-release suffix differs -- the exact-pair install is named then). MIN_QUEST_VERSION, QUEST_VERSION_FLOOR_CODE and isQuestVersionFloorFailure are retired; QUEST_VERSION_SET_HINT/INSTALL_HINT now name VERSION. Consumers: init.ts's fatal selection set uses isQuestVersionPairMismatch; tracker-migration.ts and tracker-cutover.ts drift hints name VERSION; backlog.ts and orphans.ts comments re-pointed (Backlog's floor is untouched). TESTS: quest-adapter fixtures report VERSION; the old floor accept-list and below-floor cases became both-direction refusals with message/hint/discriminator assertions plus the suffix case and a reportError exit-6 envelope case; init.test.ts's fake adapter is a mismatched pair; tracker-adapter-parity and lcli633 fixtures report VERSION; the semver-primitive cases are retargeted to Backlog's floor (the primitive still has a user). DOCS: ADR-0020 amended (Quest superseded by the pair lock; Backlog's floor stands); docs/reference/backlog-cli-contract.md's live 'minimum floor' claim corrected; the release runbook gains the bump-order constraint (the commit that bumps package.json must move CLAUDE.md's declared Quest version to X, and quest X must be on npm by then; a lore bumped ahead of its quest cannot go green, by design); CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased (breaking: a mixed pair that used to work now refuses until the older side is upgraded -- the intended cost, per the ADR). LIVE MEASUREMENT, both halves at the real CLI in one session: `bun run lore check` with the installed quest 0.11.0 and package.json 0.11.0 exits 0 (82 files, 0 errors); with a shimmed `quest` reporting 0.10.0 first on PATH, the same command refuses: 'error: the lore 0.11.0 / quest 0.10.0 pair version requirement is not met: lore 0.11.0 requires quest 0.11.0' + hint 'upgrade quest to 0.11.0: npm install -g @opum-ai/quest@0.11.0', exit 6. GATES: bun test 4811 pass / 0 fail / 1 skip (pinned runtime, solo); bun run lore check exit 0; typecheck clean; lint clean on every touched file (repo-wide `bun run lint` is blocked while a reviewer's live worktree makes biome find a nested config -- LCLI-520, re-run at PR time). STILL OWED before landing: CI on the PR; the coupling already noted for the orchestrator.
